contract.task_clause:
A company is considering a move to a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) offering instead of a traditional in-house application. Which of the following concerns is unique to SaaS?
Option A: Disaster recovery capabilities and documented recovery procedures.
Option B: User credential setup and control over the actions that employees can perform.
Option C: Allocation of software expenses and overhead charged to departments.
Option D: Ownership of processed data and costs of data migrations.
